Alex — happy to provide a more detailed technical outline. High level notes for the kickoff so Rajiv and your engineers can prep: (I'll attach an editable checklist.)

Estimated duration: 60–75 minutes (demo + Q&A + success criteria walk-through).
Suggested agenda (editable):
- 0–10m: Intros & scope (AE/PM)
- 10–35m: Technical demo (SE) — sample dataset + topology + integration points
- 35–50m: Security & data flow Q&A (SE + Security)
- 50–60m: Success criteria alignment and next steps (AE/CS + Procurement)

Minimum success criteria for the POC (draft):
- Redwood model can be invoked from Wildwood staging environment with <200ms median inference latency for typical requests (defined sample set)
- End-to-end integration (Wildwood API -> Redwood inference -> Wildwood app) completed and validated with test vectors
- Basic RBAC & audit logging visible in Redwood Console for the session window
- Procurement confirms acceptable data retention and SLA language to proceed to Dedicated trial

Owners (draft):
- Technical owner (Wildwood): Alex Nguyen
- Security owner (Wildwood): Rajiv Shah
- Redwood SE owner: Dev Patel
- Redwood AE/CS owner: Ben Carter / Marissa Cole

Attachment: poc-success-criteria.xlsx (editable)

If Thu May 13 11:00 PST works, I can prepare the demo environment snapshot and share access details the day before.
